text:
AUTH_RESULT
Description
This event replaces
AUTH_SUCCESS
,
AUTH_FAILURE
,
AUTH_ERROR
, and
AUTH_WANTCREDENTIAL
events. These four
deprecated events will be removed from a future release. The specific
result can be obtained using
AUTH::status
.
Examples
when
AUTH_RESULT
{
if
{[
AUTH
::
status
]
!=
0
}
{
HTTP
::
respond
401
}
else
{
HTTP
::
release
}
}
